name: Swimming
steps: Push off the pool wall in a streamlined horizontal position with your face in the water, body elongated, and core lightly braced.
Reach forward with one hand and pull the water past your hip as your opposite arm recovers above the surface.
Maintain a steady flutter kick from your hips with relaxed ankles while rotating your torso slightly side to side to breathe cleanly.
Continue with alternating strokes at an even pace, then slow down as you approach the wall.
tips: Turn your head smoothly to the side with your body roll to breathe rather than lifting your head straight up.
Keep your hips high near the surface by looking down toward the pool floor and kicking gently from the hips.
